description: Auckland Council publishes helicopter LiDAR point clouds and aerial imagery captured for damage assessment after the early-2023 cyclone at Muriwai, Piha, Scenic Drive, Ahuroa Road, Krippner Road, Manukau Heads Road and Titirangi, with flight dates in February and March 2023, plus a West Coast post-cyclone imagery layer. Coverage: seven named damage-assessment sites in the Auckland region; the records were last modified in July 2023. Format and access: an ArcGIS hub map page with LiDAR and imagery layers, without registration; the download route of the point cloud was not confirmed. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC BY 4.0; cost: free. Caveats: the layers cover a small set of sites, not the whole region; the point-cloud file size, density and download route were not confirmed on the hub page, which is a viewer page; the pre-event surveys needed for change detection are separate datasets. Simulation uses: post-event damage assessment of roads and buildings, benchmarks for change detection, and validation of hazard and fragility models for road infrastructure. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
